skill.name: Declare and Execute Test Dependencies
skill.description: Use pytest markers to declare test prerequisites and enforce execution order, ensuring dependent tests run only after their prerequisites pass.
skill.skill_body:
Apply @pytest.mark.depends(on=['test_prerequisite']) to declare that a test depends on one or more prerequisite tests. pytest will enforce execution order: the dependent test runs only after all listed prerequisites pass. If any prerequisite fails, the dependent test is skipped automatically.

## Objective

Enforce test execution order and dependency satisfaction
## Applicable Signals

- Test suite contains sequential dependencies
- Prerequisite test must pass before dependent test runs
- Need to skip dependent test if prerequisite fails

## Contraindications

- Tests are independent and can run in parallel
- Test dependencies are circular or create deadlocks
- Dependency chain is too deep or complex

## Workflow Steps

- Identify the prerequisite test name (e.g., 'test_prerequisite')
- Add @pytest.mark.depends(on=['test_prerequisite']) decorator to the dependent test function
- Run pytest; dependent test will execute only after prerequisite passes
- If prerequisite fails, dependent test is automatically skipped

## Constraints

- Prerequisite test name must be exact and exist in test suite
- Circular dependencies will cause pytest to fail
- Dependent test is skipped (not failed) if prerequisite fails

## Cautions

- Overuse of test dependencies can slow test execution
- Circular dependencies must be avoided
- Ensure prerequisite test names are stable and do not change

## Output Contract

- Dependent test executes only after prerequisite test passes; pytest skips dependent test if prerequisite fails. Test execution order is enforced by pytest.

## Example Executions

### Example 1

- Input: Two tests where test_dependent_function requires test_prerequisite to pass first
- Output: @pytest.mark.depends(on=['test_prerequisite']) decorator applied; test_dependent_function runs only after test_prerequisite succeeds
- Notes: If test_prerequisite fails, test_dependent_function is skipped
